input.policy: Same compact13 input and preprocessing as run016 TabM; seven missing indicators are categorical tokens, not seven extra scaled continuous features. No passenger IDs, names, spatial expert or ensemble.

preprocessing: Training-only medians (all-missing fallback zero), log1p spending, constant numerical filtering, StandardScaler and categorical vocabularies; unknown=0, missing=1. Refit all preprocessing on full outertrain after epoch selection.
validation: Existing dev and fixed outer3 folds. Stratified inner20% chooses minimum-logloss epoch, earlier wins exact tie. Reinitialize all weights, optimizer and preprocessing; refit full outertrain for exactly selected epochs. Outer validation labels never enter model fitting or epoch selection. Record actual optimizer steps in both stages.
budget: 500 epochs, patience40; explicit stage wall-clock budgets probe300/screen3600/confirm10800/export3600 seconds, checked between batches/prediction batches. Epoch-cap termination is recorded as budget_capped and cannot support a method-family rejection. Interrupted candidate has no completed CV score.
reporting: Single initialization per outer fold for first method screen. Report every fold, pooled accuracy/logloss and training curves. Historical TabM shares input/preprocessing but differs in model/training recipe; v44 has extra engineering and is a practical best baseline, not a pure architecture control. Failure only evaluates this recipe.
resources: Float32 MPS when available, otherwise CPU; backend failure aborts rather than silently changing training mid-run. MPS memory values are snapshots; RSS is process-lifetime maximum. Full model stored on CPU with preprocessing and selected-epoch metadata.
notes: Official library defaults and optimizer parameter groups. Random initialization, no pretrained weights, no downloaded predictions. Probe is resource/backprop/serialization only, not accuracy or CV.
